[{"insert":"Deficit Deadlift 

The final deadlift of the cycle. Standing on a plate means you reach farther down to the bar, which makes the hamstrings and glutes work harder off the floor. Reps are at their lowest this week, so this should be the heaviest pulling of all six weeks. Brace hard before each pull and try to beat Week 4.
"}]
